BrowserAck.description: Unsequenced cumulative acknowledgement of the other direction.
BrowserAck.name: BrowserAck
BrowserAck.title: BrowserAck

BrowserCommand.description: Agent command for an existing session. rid is scoped to (hostId, session) for deduplication. session is the raw session ID; omitted hostId selects local. A reply reports dispatch outcome, not necessarily completion of the resulting turn.
BrowserCommand.name: BrowserCommand
BrowserCommand.title: BrowserCommand

BrowserEvent.description: Multiplexed subscription event: name chooses the subscribed channel or mux controls; data is a JSON value and the worker preserves its serialization. Consumers decode by channel and inner discriminator. Session cursors are independent of link acknowledgements; a merged delta's web.first marks the first sequence represented, and a snapshot inside that range cannot safely apply it.
BrowserEvent.name: BrowserEvent
BrowserEvent.title: BrowserEvent

BrowserHello.description: First text frame; token is null for a new link, otherwise an owner-bound resume token. ack is the last applied server sequence.
BrowserHello.name: BrowserHello
BrowserHello.title: BrowserHello

BrowserPart.description: Sequenced slice of a larger JSON line; at is the UTF-16 offset, data is text, end marks the final slice. Reassemble before applying the joined line.
BrowserPart.name: BrowserPart
BrowserPart.title: BrowserPart

BrowserPing.description: Unsequenced heartbeat. Browser clock pings carry c; server heartbeats carry at.
BrowserPing.name: BrowserPing
BrowserPing.title: BrowserPing

BrowserPong.description: Unsequenced reply to a browser clock ping, echoing c and providing server epoch milliseconds at.
BrowserPong.name: BrowserPong
BrowserPong.title: BrowserPong

BrowserReply.description: Command response; data is the opaque JSON response body. recvAt and at are server epoch milliseconds; deduped indicates a remembered run or reply.
BrowserReply.name: BrowserReply
BrowserReply.title: BrowserReply

BrowserRequest_abort.description:
Usage: Abort the active run and pending input.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Cancellation does not undo already completed side effects.
Effects: Stops goal continuation and builtin work, voids queued input and aborts the run.
Recovery: Inspect state and transcript after uncertainty; recover editor input separately.

Browser: Abort the current turn. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
BrowserRequest_abort.name: BrowserRequest_abort
BrowserRequest_abort.title: BrowserRequest_abort

BrowserRequest_abort_and_prompt.description:
Usage: Abort the current run and submit replacement input asynchronously.
Inputs: Provide message, optional images and clientMessageId.
Invariants: The reply follows abort but may precede replacement admission; later dispatch errors arrive as prompt_error and prompt_result.
Effects: Stops the active run and schedules replacement input; completed side effects are not undone.
Recovery: Reconcile the clientMessageId and observe prompt_result after uncertainty before resending.

Browser: Abort the current turn and submit a new prompt. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
BrowserRequest_abort_and_prompt.name: BrowserRequest_abort_and_prompt
BrowserRequest_abort_and_prompt.title: BrowserRequest_abort_and_prompt

BrowserRequest_abort_and_restore_queue.description:
Usage: Abort and recover queued input for an editor.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Queue entries are withdrawn before abort so the interrupted run cannot consume them.
Effects: Stops the run and returns steering and follow-up messages; prior effects are not rolled back.
Recovery: Restore the returned messages in the editor; inspect session state if the response was lost.
BrowserRequest_abort_and_restore_queue.name: BrowserRequest_abort_and_restore_queue
BrowserRequest_abort_and_restore_queue.title: BrowserRequest_abort_and_restore_queue

BrowserRequest_abort_bash.description:
Usage: Abort the active shell command.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Aborting cannot undo effects the command already made.
Effects: Signals the shell execution to stop.
Recovery: Inspect shell result and external state after uncertainty.
BrowserRequest_abort_bash.name: BrowserRequest_abort_bash
BrowserRequest_abort_bash.title: BrowserRequest_abort_bash

BrowserRequest_abort_compaction.description:
Usage: Abort in-flight compaction.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: This requests cancellation rather than reversing a completed compaction.
Effects: Signals the compaction operation to stop.
Recovery: Inspect compaction state and history after uncertainty.

Browser: Abort in-flight compaction through the runner abort operation. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
BrowserRequest_abort_compaction.name: BrowserRequest_abort_compaction
BrowserRequest_abort_compaction.title: BrowserRequest_abort_compaction

BrowserRequest_abort_retry.description:
Usage: Abort a pending retry.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Already completed work is not rolled back.
Effects: Signals the pending retry to stop.
Recovery: Inspect session activity after uncertainty.
BrowserRequest_abort_retry.name: BrowserRequest_abort_retry
BrowserRequest_abort_retry.title: BrowserRequest_abort_retry

BrowserRequest_bash.description:
Usage: Execute a shell command while streaming bash_output frames.
Inputs: Supply command and optionally excludeFromContext.
Invariants: Output frames are incremental; the result follows execution.
Effects: Runs a shell command with its ordinary filesystem and process side effects.
Recovery: Inspect external state after uncertainty; rerunning a shell command may duplicate side effects.

Browser: Execute a shell command; deferred indicates the result was held for the next prompt. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
BrowserRequest_bash.name: BrowserRequest_bash
BrowserRequest_bash.title: BrowserRequest_bash

BrowserRequest_btw.description:
Usage: Ask a side question or continue an existing record.
Inputs: question is text; omit recordId to start a record.
Invariants: Only one side question runs at a time; deltas and snapshots carry recordId.
Effects: Streams an answer and checkpoints turns to the session history sidecar.
Recovery: Inspect history after an uncertain response before submitting another question.
BrowserRequest_btw.name: BrowserRequest_btw
BrowserRequest_btw.title: BrowserRequest_btw

BrowserRequest_btw_cancel.description:
Usage: Cancel the active side question.
Inputs: Omit recordId to target the active record, or supply its id.
Invariants: cancelled reports whether a matching active request was cancelled.
Effects: Interrupts the answer; its lifecycle is checkpointed.
Recovery: Read history to determine the outcome if the response is lost.
BrowserRequest_btw_cancel.name: BrowserRequest_btw_cancel
BrowserRequest_btw_cancel.title: BrowserRequest_btw_cancel

BrowserRequest_cancel_job.description:
Usage: Request cancellation of a scoped job or service.
Inputs: Supply its id, kind, incarnation and generation from a current snapshot.
Invariants: A cancellation request is not proof that work has stopped; stale identities and forbidden targets fail.
Effects: Signals the selected job or service; already produced output is not rolled back.
Recovery: Refresh the snapshot and inspect status after uncertainty; do not reuse an identity from a replaced runner.
BrowserRequest_cancel_job.name: BrowserRequest_cancel_job
BrowserRequest_cancel_job.title: BrowserRequest_cancel_job

BrowserRequest_commit_apply.description:
Usage: Apply a proposed or edited commit plan while the session is settled.
Inputs: plan contains commit groups, dependencies and changelog proposals.
Invariants: Split plans must cover staged files and have valid dependency order.
Effects: Writes changelogs and creates commits; split plans unstage and stage hunks in dependency order.
Recovery: Inspect commits, changelog and index after failure; partial application is not rolled back.
BrowserRequest_commit_apply.name: BrowserRequest_commit_apply
BrowserRequest_commit_apply.title: BrowserRequest_commit_apply

BrowserRequest_commit_plan.description:
Usage: Propose commits for the workspace while the session is settled.
Inputs: Optional context guides the proposal; changelog false disables changelog detection. Optional requestId correlates unsolicited commit_plan_progress frames.
Invariants: Returns null if no staged changes remain after staging the workspace; progress is emitted only when requestId is supplied.
Effects: Stages all workspace changes, including partially staged files; may invoke a model.
Recovery: Inspect the Git index after errors or lost responses; staging is not rolled back.
BrowserRequest_commit_plan.name: BrowserRequest_commit_plan
BrowserRequest_commit_plan.title: BrowserRequest_commit_plan

BrowserRequest_compact.description:
Usage: Compact session context.
Inputs: customInstructions may be omitted.
Invariants: Compaction may be aborted and is not a transcript deletion guarantee.
Effects: Produces and persists a compacted context summary.
Recovery: Inspect session state and history after uncertainty before compacting again.
BrowserRequest_compact.name: BrowserRequest_compact
BrowserRequest_compact.title: BrowserRequest_compact

BrowserRequest_cycle_model.description:
Usage: Cycle the available session models.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Result may be null; isScoped reports whether selection used the configured model scope.
Effects: Selects the next model when available.
Recovery: Read current state after uncertainty rather than cycling again blindly.
BrowserRequest_cycle_model.name: BrowserRequest_cycle_model
BrowserRequest_cycle_model.title: BrowserRequest_cycle_model

BrowserRequest_cycle_thinking_level.description:
Usage: Cycle available thinking levels.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Null means no level was selected.
Effects: Changes the current thinking level when possible.
Recovery: Read state after uncertainty rather than cycling again blindly.
BrowserRequest_cycle_thinking_level.name: BrowserRequest_cycle_thinking_level
BrowserRequest_cycle_thinking_level.title: BrowserRequest_cycle_thinking_level

BrowserRequest_edit_message.description:
Usage: Prepare a user message for editing by moving the leaf before it.
Inputs: Supply the user message entryId.
Invariants: The session must have no snapshot-busy or pending asynchronous work; the old branch remains in the tree.
Effects: Persists the navigation, but does not submit edited text.
Recovery: Inspect session identity and leaf after uncertainty before editing or resending.

Browser: Move the history leaf before a user message; fails with invalid_edit_target, session_busy, session_changed or session_edit_unsupported when preflight cannot safely edit. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
BrowserRequest_edit_message.name: BrowserRequest_edit_message
BrowserRequest_edit_message.title: BrowserRequest_edit_message

BrowserRequest_export_html.description:
Usage: Export the transcript to HTML.
Inputs: outputPath may be omitted to use the default.
Invariants: The result returns the output path.
Effects: Writes an HTML file to disk.
Recovery: Inspect the output path after uncertainty before exporting again.
BrowserRequest_export_html.name: BrowserRequest_export_html
BrowserRequest_export_html.title: BrowserRequest_export_html

BrowserRequest_follow_up.description:
Usage: Enqueue follow-up input.
Inputs: Provide message, optional images and clientMessageId.
Invariants: Acknowledgement follows admission, not completion; the queue is session state.
Effects: Adds follow-up input for the agent.
Recovery: Reconcile an uncertain correlated input and inspect the queue before resubmitting.

Browser: Queue a follow-up message. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
BrowserRequest_follow_up.name: BrowserRequest_follow_up
BrowserRequest_follow_up.title: BrowserRequest_follow_up

BrowserRequest_fork.description:
Usage: Fork a session snapshot at an optional entry.
Inputs: entryId may be omitted.
Invariants: The session must be idle for a consistent snapshot; idleness is rechecked after awaits.
Effects: Switches to the fork unless cancelled.
Recovery: Inspect current session identity after uncertainty; retry session_busy only once work has settled.

Browser: Branch at a user message and switch this process to the new session. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
BrowserRequest_fork.name: BrowserRequest_fork
BrowserRequest_fork.title: BrowserRequest_fork

BrowserRequest_generate_pr_description.description:
Usage: Generate a PR title and body from the current branch and staged diff.
Inputs: base is a Git ref; context and plannedMessages are optional.
Invariants: Commits are oldest first; the staged diff is bounded and generation requires changes.
Effects: Reads Git and session history and calls the configured model; does not create a PR.
Recovery: Retry generation if needed; output can differ and malformed model output falls back to the log.
BrowserRequest_generate_pr_description.name: BrowserRequest_generate_pr_description
BrowserRequest_generate_pr_description.title: BrowserRequest_generate_pr_description

BrowserRequest_get_available_models.description:
Usage: List currently available models.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Waits for background discovery; results reflect the current registry.
Effects: Reads model availability without selecting a model.
Recovery: Refresh after discovery or provider configuration changes.
BrowserRequest_get_available_models.name: BrowserRequest_get_available_models
BrowserRequest_get_available_models.title: BrowserRequest_get_available_models

BrowserRequest_get_branch_messages.description:
Usage: List user messages available for branching.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Entry ids refer to the current session tree.
Effects: Reads branch candidates without navigating.
Recovery: Refresh after session or tree changes.
BrowserRequest_get_branch_messages.name: BrowserRequest_get_branch_messages
BrowserRequest_get_branch_messages.title: BrowserRequest_get_branch_messages

BrowserRequest_get_btw_history.description:
Usage: Read side-question history for the current session.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Records are newest first and include follow-up turns.
Effects: Reads the session history sidecar without changing it.
Recovery: Retry a failed read; history reflects saved checkpoints.
BrowserRequest_get_btw_history.name: BrowserRequest_get_btw_history
BrowserRequest_get_btw_history.title: BrowserRequest_get_btw_history

BrowserRequest_get_client_message_status.description:
Usage: Recover correlation for one to 32 unique client message IDs.
Inputs: Supply unique nonempty IDs up to 128 characters each.
Invariants: Status reflects this session's in-flight and journaled input; bounded responses can omit oversized native messages.
Effects: Reads correlation state without submitting input.
Recovery: Use session history when messages are omitted; do not treat an uncertain transport as proof of non-admission.

Browser: Reconciliation does not start a child; a missing child or uncertain host fails instead of guessing acceptance.
BrowserRequest_get_client_message_status.name: BrowserRequest_get_client_message_status
BrowserRequest_get_client_message_status.title: BrowserRequest_get_client_message_status

BrowserRequest_get_commands.description:
Usage: List available slash commands.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: The list reflects current session capabilities.
Effects: Reads the current command registry.
Recovery: Refresh after extensions or session configuration change.

Browser: Dispatches the runner's get_available_commands operation.
BrowserRequest_get_commands.name: BrowserRequest_get_commands
BrowserRequest_get_commands.title: BrowserRequest_get_commands

BrowserRequest_get_job_output.description:
Usage: Read one job or service's output.
Inputs: Supply its id, kind, incarnation and generation from a current snapshot; cursor defaults to zero.
Invariants: Identity is bound to the runner generation and job incarnation; bash sources honor the cursor, while service logs and non-stream sources return bounded snapshots from zero. Output may be truncated.
Effects: Reads current output without cancelling the job.
Recovery: On stale_generation or job_not_found refresh the list; invalid_args requires correcting the request.
BrowserRequest_get_job_output.name: BrowserRequest_get_job_output
BrowserRequest_get_job_output.title: BrowserRequest_get_job_output

BrowserRequest_get_jobs.description:
Usage: List jobs and services scoped to the current session.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: This is a live snapshot; a service-list failure appears in servicesError.
Effects: Reads runner and daemon state without starting work.
Recovery: Refresh the snapshot after a restart or service-list failure.
BrowserRequest_get_jobs.name: BrowserRequest_get_jobs
BrowserRequest_get_jobs.title: BrowserRequest_get_jobs

BrowserRequest_get_last_assistant_text.description:
Usage: Read the latest assistant text.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Text is omitted when there is no assistant text.
Effects: Reads the current transcript without modifying it.
Recovery: Refresh after the transcript changes.

Browser: Read the latest assistant text, defaulting to an empty string. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
BrowserRequest_get_last_assistant_text.name: BrowserRequest_get_last_assistant_text
BrowserRequest_get_last_assistant_text.title: BrowserRequest_get_last_assistant_text

BrowserRequest_get_login_providers.description:
Usage: List OAuth providers and authentication state.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Availability comes from the provider catalog and authentication from credential storage.
Effects: Reads current in-process registry and stored credential state.
Recovery: Refresh the list after login or logout.
BrowserRequest_get_login_providers.name: BrowserRequest_get_login_providers
BrowserRequest_get_login_providers.title: BrowserRequest_get_login_providers

BrowserRequest_get_messages.description:
Usage: Read the live transcript.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: This is the current in-memory transcript and may change during a run.
Effects: Reads messages without modifying them.
Recovery: Refresh after reconnecting or use bounded paging while idle.
BrowserRequest_get_messages.name: BrowserRequest_get_messages
BrowserRequest_get_messages.title: BrowserRequest_get_messages

BrowserRequest_get_messages_page.description:
Usage: Read a bounded page of the live transcript.
Inputs: Omit cursor for the first page; limit defaults to 100 and is at most 256.
Invariants: Pages are bounded by a byte budget; a transcript change makes cursors stale and streaming or compaction rejects paging.
Effects: Reads an in-memory snapshot without modifying the transcript.
Recovery: Restart from the first page after a stale cursor or once the session is idle.
BrowserRequest_get_messages_page.name: BrowserRequest_get_messages_page
BrowserRequest_get_messages_page.title: BrowserRequest_get_messages_page

BrowserRequest_get_session_stats.description:
Usage: Read session usage statistics.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Statistics describe the current session snapshot.
Effects: Reads usage without changing the session.
Recovery: Refresh after further activity.

Browser: Read session statistics with the wrapper's current session name. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
BrowserRequest_get_session_stats.name: BrowserRequest_get_session_stats
BrowserRequest_get_session_stats.title: BrowserRequest_get_session_stats

BrowserRequest_get_state.description:
Usage: Read live session state.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: This is a current in-process snapshot, not a durable history or completion guarantee.
Effects: Reads model, queue, goal, tools and activity state without submitting work.
Recovery: Refresh after reconnecting or when state changes.

Browser: Read browser state, including wrapper activity and extension UI state. Optional hostId selects the host for this session; a live wrapper on another host is refused. The routing hint is not sent to the runner. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
BrowserRequest_get_state.name: BrowserRequest_get_state
BrowserRequest_get_state.title: BrowserRequest_get_state

BrowserRequest_get_subagent_messages.description:
Usage: Incrementally read an owned subagent transcript.
Inputs: Identify it by subagentId or sessionFile; fromByte defaults to zero and is a UTF-8 byte offset.
Invariants: Only current-session-owned transcripts are accessible; only newline-complete entries advance nextByte. An offset past EOF resets to zero.
Effects: Reads the transcript file without modifying it; messages are the message entries in order.
Recovery: Resume at nextByte; on reset discard the old view and rebuild from zero.
BrowserRequest_get_subagent_messages.name: BrowserRequest_get_subagent_messages
BrowserRequest_get_subagent_messages.title: BrowserRequest_get_subagent_messages

BrowserRequest_get_subagents.description:
Usage: Inspect the current session's observed subagent roster.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: The in-memory roster only knows lifecycle events observed since watching began, ordered by index then id.
Effects: Returns a snapshot without changing subagents.
Recovery: Refresh the snapshot; it is not a durable complete history.
BrowserRequest_get_subagents.name: BrowserRequest_get_subagents
BrowserRequest_get_subagents.title: BrowserRequest_get_subagents

BrowserRequest_handoff.description:
Usage: Compact the current session with an OMP handoff summary.
Inputs: Optional string customInstructions guides the summary.
Invariants: Compaction runs in the background without interrupting an active response. OMP rejects overlapping compaction or a session transition.
Effects: Updates the current session's context, not a separate session. The runner waits for compaction to finish before replying with {}; compaction errors fail the command.
Recovery: If delivery is uncertain, inspect session state and manual_compaction_end before retrying.
BrowserRequest_handoff.name: BrowserRequest_handoff
BrowserRequest_handoff.title: BrowserRequest_handoff

BrowserRequest_host_tool_result.description:
Usage: Return a result for a pending host tool call.
Inputs: Supply the result frame fields without the type discriminator.
Invariants: The result belongs to the corresponding host tool invocation.
Effects: Forwards the result to the runner.
Recovery: Reconcile pending calls after a disconnect rather than inventing a result.
BrowserRequest_host_tool_result.name: BrowserRequest_host_tool_result
BrowserRequest_host_tool_result.title: BrowserRequest_host_tool_result

BrowserRequest_host_uri_result.description:
Usage: Return a result for a pending host URI operation.
Inputs: Supply the result frame fields without the type discriminator.
Invariants: The result belongs to the corresponding URI request.
Effects: Forwards the result to the runner.
Recovery: Reconcile pending requests after a disconnect rather than inventing a result.
BrowserRequest_host_uri_result.name: BrowserRequest_host_uri_result
BrowserRequest_host_uri_result.title: BrowserRequest_host_uri_result

BrowserRequest_login.description:
Usage: Authenticate an OAuth provider interactively.
Inputs: providerId names a known provider; answer numeric-id prompts with login_input_response.
Invariants: Prompts time out after ten minutes; omitted or null answers cancel the input.
Effects: Stores credentials, refreshes provider discovery online and refreshes scoped models.
Recovery: Check authentication state after uncertainty; login may have stored credentials before a refresh failed.
BrowserRequest_login.name: BrowserRequest_login
BrowserRequest_login.title: BrowserRequest_login

BrowserRequest_new_session.description:
Usage: Create a session, optionally linked to a parent.
Inputs: parentSession may be omitted.
Invariants: A cancelled change does not detach the current run.
Effects: On success switches the process to the new session.
Recovery: Inspect current identity after uncertainty before creating another session.

Browser: Switch the runner session and return its refreshed identity when not cancelled. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
BrowserRequest_new_session.name: BrowserRequest_new_session
BrowserRequest_new_session.title: BrowserRequest_new_session

BrowserRequest_outbox_add.description:
Usage: Durably accept a held outbox message, independently of its eventual delivery.
Inputs: Supply id and scope; first insertion also requires mode and message. Images and completed uploads are optional; replaces identifies an earlier entry.
Invariants: Reusing an existing id on the same host returns its stored receipt, including the owning host ID, without dispatching again. Replacing a failed or delivered entry requires the same original payload; pending originals cannot be replaced. Scope, upload, size and capacity checks can reject the request.
Effects: Stores an entry for later delivery; acceptance does not mean the runner has admitted or completed a prompt.
Recovery: Retry an uncertain insertion with the same id and scope to recover its receipt; resolve scope or payload conflicts rather than changing the original intent.
BrowserRequest_outbox_add.name: BrowserRequest_outbox_add
BrowserRequest_outbox_add.title: BrowserRequest_outbox_add

BrowserRequest_outbox_remove.description:
Usage: Retire an undelivered outbox entry.
Inputs: Supply its id.
Invariants: An entry already delivering cannot be removed and fails with outbox_dispatched.
Effects: Removes an eligible held entry; this does not cancel an already dispatched prompt.
Recovery: Inspect the outbox and delivery status after an uncertain response.
BrowserRequest_outbox_remove.name: BrowserRequest_outbox_remove
BrowserRequest_outbox_remove.title: BrowserRequest_outbox_remove

BrowserRequest_outbox_scope.description:
Usage: Obtain the scope for a durable outbox entry.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: The scope is nonsecret and binds entries to the installation and sign-in.
Effects: Reads the current scope without dispatching input.
Recovery: Refresh the scope after a sign-in change before adding entries.
BrowserRequest_outbox_scope.name: BrowserRequest_outbox_scope
BrowserRequest_outbox_scope.title: BrowserRequest_outbox_scope

BrowserRequest_predict_word.description:
Usage: Request composer ghost text.
Inputs: text and cursor, an in-range UTF-16 offset.
Invariants: Disabled prediction, ineligible cursor positions and superseded waiting requests return null.
Effects: May invoke the configured prediction backend; concurrent typing is coalesced.
Recovery: Request again with current text and cursor rather than applying stale suffixes.
BrowserRequest_predict_word.name: BrowserRequest_predict_word
BrowserRequest_predict_word.title: BrowserRequest_predict_word

BrowserRequest_predict_word_feedback.description:
Usage: Report whether a prediction was accepted.
Inputs: text, UTF-16 cursor, suggestion and accepted flag.
Invariants: Feedback is ignored when prediction is off or the cursor is ineligible.
Effects: Sends feedback to the configured prediction backend when applicable.
Recovery: A lost response does not establish whether feedback was recorded.
BrowserRequest_predict_word_feedback.name: BrowserRequest_predict_word_feedback
BrowserRequest_predict_word_feedback.title: BrowserRequest_predict_word_feedback

BrowserRequest_promote_queued_message.description:
Usage: Promote a queued message.
Inputs: Supply its message text.
Invariants: The result reports whether a match was promoted.
Effects: Changes the queued message's priority.
Recovery: Inspect the queue after an uncertain response.
BrowserRequest_promote_queued_message.name: BrowserRequest_promote_queued_message
BrowserRequest_promote_queued_message.title: BrowserRequest_promote_queued_message

BrowserRequest_prompt.description:
Usage: Submit user input to the session.
Inputs: Provide message and optional images, clientMessageId and streamingBehavior.
Invariants: The reply acknowledges admission, not completion; local builtins can report agentInvoked without a normal agent turn. A clientMessageId is unique within the session's correlation journal, not a global retry key.
Effects: Runs input hooks and may enqueue or start an agent turn.
Recovery: Reconcile an uncertain correlated submission with get_client_message_status; observe prompt result and settled state separately.

Browser: Submit a prompt; while a shell is running it is queued as follow-up. Local slash commands may report agentInvoked:false. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
BrowserRequest_prompt.name: BrowserRequest_prompt
BrowserRequest_prompt.title: BrowserRequest_prompt

BrowserRequest_reload.description:
Usage: Restart the session process.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: A successful response reports that restart was requested, not that an interrupted prompt completed.
Effects: Replaces the process and its in-memory state.
Recovery: Refresh session state and reconcile outstanding input after restart.
BrowserRequest_reload.name: BrowserRequest_reload
BrowserRequest_reload.title: BrowserRequest_reload

BrowserRequest_remove_queued_message.description:
Usage: Remove a matching queued message.
Inputs: Supply message text and steering or followUp queue.
Invariants: The result says whether a match was found and includes its images when present.
Effects: Removes the matching queued input.
Recovery: Inspect the queue after an uncertain response before removing again.
BrowserRequest_remove_queued_message.name: BrowserRequest_remove_queued_message
BrowserRequest_remove_queued_message.title: BrowserRequest_remove_queued_message

BrowserRequest_set_auto_compaction.description:
Usage: Configure automatic compaction.
Inputs: Supply enabled.
Invariants: This changes the setting, not an existing compaction result.
Effects: Enables or disables future automatic compaction.
Recovery: Read session state after uncertainty.
BrowserRequest_set_auto_compaction.name: BrowserRequest_set_auto_compaction
BrowserRequest_set_auto_compaction.title: BrowserRequest_set_auto_compaction

BrowserRequest_set_auto_retry.description:
Usage: Configure automatic retry.
Inputs: Supply enabled.
Invariants: This is separate from aborting a pending retry.
Effects: Enables or disables future automatic retries.
Recovery: Inspect current configuration after uncertainty.
BrowserRequest_set_auto_retry.name: BrowserRequest_set_auto_retry
BrowserRequest_set_auto_retry.title: BrowserRequest_set_auto_retry

BrowserRequest_set_fast_mode.description:
Usage: Set fast mode.
Inputs: Supply enabled.
Invariants: Enabled and active are distinct: the current model determines whether fast mode is active.
Effects: Changes the session fast-mode setting.
Recovery: Read state after uncertainty before reapplying.

Browser: Enable or disable fast mode; the wrapper reports effective and active state. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
BrowserRequest_set_fast_mode.name: BrowserRequest_set_fast_mode
BrowserRequest_set_fast_mode.title: BrowserRequest_set_fast_mode

BrowserRequest_set_follow_up_mode.description:
Usage: Set follow-up queue mode.
Inputs: mode is all or one-at-a-time.
Invariants: The setting is session-only and is not persisted.
Effects: Changes how follow-up messages are consumed.
Recovery: Read state and reapply the desired mode after restart.
BrowserRequest_set_follow_up_mode.name: BrowserRequest_set_follow_up_mode
BrowserRequest_set_follow_up_mode.title: BrowserRequest_set_follow_up_mode

BrowserRequest_set_host_tools.description:
Usage: Register host-provided tools for the session.
Inputs: Supply the host tool definitions.
Invariants: Definitions are merged with enabled web-server tools.
Effects: Changes the tools exposed to the runner.
Recovery: Re-register host tools when the owning host reconnects.
BrowserRequest_set_host_tools.name: BrowserRequest_set_host_tools
BrowserRequest_set_host_tools.title: BrowserRequest_set_host_tools

BrowserRequest_set_host_uri_schemes.description:
Usage: Register host URI schemes.
Inputs: Supply the schemes supported by the host.
Invariants: Registration describes host capabilities, not URI operation results.
Effects: Updates schemes available to the runner.
Recovery: Re-register capabilities after the host reconnects.
BrowserRequest_set_host_uri_schemes.name: BrowserRequest_set_host_uri_schemes
BrowserRequest_set_host_uri_schemes.title: BrowserRequest_set_host_uri_schemes

BrowserRequest_set_interrupt_mode.description:
Usage: Set interrupt mode.
Inputs: mode is immediate or wait.
Invariants: The setting is session-only and is not persisted.
Effects: Changes how the session handles interruptions.
Recovery: Read state and reapply the desired mode after restart.
BrowserRequest_set_interrupt_mode.name: BrowserRequest_set_interrupt_mode
BrowserRequest_set_interrupt_mode.title: BrowserRequest_set_interrupt_mode

BrowserRequest_set_model.description:
Usage: Select an exact provider and model for this session.
Inputs: Supply both provider and modelId.
Invariants: A miss waits for background discovery and refreshes that provider on the session's host before failing.
Effects: Changes the active session model.
Recovery: Read state or available models after an uncertain response before selecting again.

Browser: Select the model; the browser receives its id and provider. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
BrowserRequest_set_model.name: BrowserRequest_set_model
BrowserRequest_set_model.title: BrowserRequest_set_model

BrowserRequest_set_session_name.description:
Usage: Set the session title.
Inputs: Supply name; surrounding whitespace is trimmed.
Invariants: The title belongs to the current session.
Effects: Changes the session name.
Recovery: Read current state after uncertainty before reapplying.

Browser: Set and cache the trimmed session name. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
BrowserRequest_set_session_name.name: BrowserRequest_set_session_name
BrowserRequest_set_session_name.title: BrowserRequest_set_session_name

BrowserRequest_set_slow_mode.description:
Usage: Set slow mode.
Inputs: Supply enabled.
Invariants: Support and scope depend on the current session model.
Effects: Changes the slow-mode setting and returns its effective enabled state.
Recovery: Read state after uncertainty before reapplying.

Browser: Enable or disable slow mode; the wrapper reports effective state. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
BrowserRequest_set_slow_mode.name: BrowserRequest_set_slow_mode
BrowserRequest_set_slow_mode.title: BrowserRequest_set_slow_mode

BrowserRequest_set_steering_mode.description:
Usage: Set steering queue mode.
Inputs: mode is all or one-at-a-time.
Invariants: The setting is session-only and is not persisted.
Effects: Changes how steering messages are consumed.
Recovery: Read state and reapply the desired mode after restart.
BrowserRequest_set_steering_mode.name: BrowserRequest_set_steering_mode
BrowserRequest_set_steering_mode.title: BrowserRequest_set_steering_mode

BrowserRequest_set_subagent_subscription.description:
Usage: Subscribe to subagent updates.
Inputs: Supply the desired subscription level.
Invariants: The result is null when the host owns subscription lifecycle; otherwise it reports the level.
Effects: Changes update subscription state.
Recovery: Restore the desired subscription after reconnecting.
BrowserRequest_set_subagent_subscription.name: BrowserRequest_set_subagent_subscription
BrowserRequest_set_subagent_subscription.title: BrowserRequest_set_subagent_subscription

BrowserRequest_set_thinking_level.description:
Usage: Set the thinking level.
Inputs: Supply level.
Invariants: Valid levels depend on the configured model.
Effects: Changes the session thinking setting.
Recovery: Read state after uncertainty before reapplying.
BrowserRequest_set_thinking_level.name: BrowserRequest_set_thinking_level
BrowserRequest_set_thinking_level.title: BrowserRequest_set_thinking_level

BrowserRequest_set_todos.description:
Usage: Replace session todo phases.
Inputs: Supply the complete phases array with tasks and statuses.
Invariants: This replaces rather than patches the existing phases.
Effects: Commits the supplied todo state and returns the resulting phases.
Recovery: Read session state after uncertainty before replacing again.
BrowserRequest_set_todos.name: BrowserRequest_set_todos
BrowserRequest_set_todos.title: BrowserRequest_set_todos

BrowserRequest_steer.description:
Usage: Steer the current run.
Inputs: Provide message, optional images and clientMessageId.
Invariants: Admission is ordered with other user input; acknowledgement is not turn completion.
Effects: Delivers or queues steering input after input hooks.
Recovery: Reconcile an uncertain correlated input before sending another.

Browser: Steer a live run; while a shell is running it is queued as follow-up. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
BrowserRequest_steer.name: BrowserRequest_steer
BrowserRequest_steer.title: BrowserRequest_steer

BrowserRequest_switch_session.description:
Usage: Switch to a session file.
Inputs: Supply sessionPath and optionally both provider and modelId.
Invariants: A cancelled switch leaves the current session in place.
Effects: On success changes session and may detach a live run.
Recovery: Inspect current identity after uncertainty before switching again.

Browser: Switch the runner session and return its refreshed identity when not cancelled. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
BrowserRequest_switch_session.name: BrowserRequest_switch_session
BrowserRequest_switch_session.title: BrowserRequest_switch_session

BrowserRequest_ui_input.description:
Usage: Send keyboard input to a custom extension UI component.
Inputs: Supply its numeric id and input data.
Invariants: Input targets the currently active component identified by id.
Effects: Forwards input to the extension UI.
Recovery: Refresh UI state after a disconnect before sending further input.
BrowserRequest_ui_input.name: BrowserRequest_ui_input
BrowserRequest_ui_input.title: BrowserRequest_ui_input

BrowserRequest_ui_response.description:
Usage: Answer a pending runner dialog or server confirmation.
Inputs: Supply the dialog id and optional answer value.
Invariants: Invalid ids or answers fail with invalid_ui_response.
Effects: Resolves the matching pending interaction.
Recovery: Refresh pending UI state after uncertainty; an already resolved dialog is not a new request.
BrowserRequest_ui_response.name: BrowserRequest_ui_response
BrowserRequest_ui_response.title: BrowserRequest_ui_response

BrowserSubscribe.description: Subscribe to a channel; id is also the event name and matches ^s[0-9]{1,15}$.
BrowserSubscribe.name: BrowserSubscribe
BrowserSubscribe.title: BrowserSubscribe

BrowserUploadAbort.description: Abort an upload; host may be omitted.
BrowserUploadAbort.name: BrowserUploadAbort
BrowserUploadAbort.title: BrowserUploadAbort

BrowserUploadAck.description: Upload progress in bytes. start identifies the up_start generation; proof is an optional string only on completion and must be passed through unchanged.
BrowserUploadAck.name: BrowserUploadAck
BrowserUploadAck.title: BrowserUploadAck

BrowserUploadBinary.description: Binary WebSocket frame: unsigned one-byte UTF-8 id length, id bytes, then upload payload bytes (at most 262144 bytes). Only an upload started on this link is accepted; binary chunks are not sequenced.
BrowserUploadBinary.name: BrowserUploadBinary
BrowserUploadBinary.title: BrowserUploadBinary

BrowserUploadError.description: Upload failure. start echoes the up_start generation when present; an invalid start may be any JSON value.
BrowserUploadError.name: BrowserUploadError
BrowserUploadError.title: BrowserUploadError

BrowserUploadStart.description: Open or resume an upload. n identifies this start generation; ignore acknowledgements for older generations. mime is the file MIME type, size and acknowledged offsets are bytes.
BrowserUploadStart.name: BrowserUploadStart
BrowserUploadStart.title: BrowserUploadStart

BrowserWelcome.description: Resume result and server identity; ack is the last applied browser sequence. If resumed is false, rebuild subscriptions and reconcile outstanding commands.
BrowserWelcome.name: BrowserWelcome
BrowserWelcome.title: BrowserWelcome

BrowserAck.description: Unsequenced cumulative acknowledgement of the other direction.
BrowserAck.title: BrowserAck

BrowserCommand.description: Agent command for an existing session. rid is scoped to (hostId, session) for deduplication. session is the raw session ID; omitted hostId selects local. A reply reports dispatch outcome, not necessarily completion of the resulting turn.

anyOf.description:
Usage: Abort the active run and pending input.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Cancellation does not undo already completed side effects.
Effects: Stops goal continuation and builtin work, voids queued input and aborts the run.
Recovery: Inspect state and transcript after uncertainty; recover editor input separately.

Browser: Abort the current turn. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_abort

clientMessageId.description: Session-scoped correlation identity; use status reconciliation after uncertain delivery.

images.description: Optional inline image content accompanying the input.

data.description: Base64-encoded image data.

mimeType.description: Image media type.

message.description: User input text submitted to the session.

uploadProofs.description: Private upload completion proofs keyed by upload ID; never forwarded to the runner.

uploads.description: Completed upload IDs attached before the native command is sent.

anyOf.description:
Usage: Abort the current run and submit replacement input asynchronously.
Inputs: Provide message, optional images and clientMessageId.
Invariants: The reply follows abort but may precede replacement admission; later dispatch errors arrive as prompt_error and prompt_result.
Effects: Stops the active run and schedules replacement input; completed side effects are not undone.
Recovery: Reconcile the clientMessageId and observe prompt_result after uncertainty before resending.

Browser: Abort the current turn and submit a new prompt. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_abort_and_prompt

anyOf.description:
Usage: Set the thinking level.
Inputs: Supply level.
Invariants: Valid levels depend on the configured model.
Effects: Changes the session thinking setting.
Recovery: Read state after uncertainty before reapplying.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_set_thinking_level

anyOf.description:
Usage: Cycle available thinking levels.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Null means no level was selected.
Effects: Changes the current thinking level when possible.
Recovery: Read state after uncertainty rather than cycling again blindly.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_cycle_thinking_level

anyOf.description:
Usage: Cycle the available session models.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Result may be null; isScoped reports whether selection used the configured model scope.
Effects: Selects the next model when available.
Recovery: Read current state after uncertainty rather than cycling again blindly.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_cycle_model

anyOf.description:
Usage: List currently available models.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Waits for background discovery; results reflect the current registry.
Effects: Reads model availability without selecting a model.
Recovery: Refresh after discovery or provider configuration changes.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_get_available_models

anyOf.description:
Usage: Configure automatic compaction.
Inputs: Supply enabled.
Invariants: This changes the setting, not an existing compaction result.
Effects: Enables or disables future automatic compaction.
Recovery: Read session state after uncertainty.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_set_auto_compaction

anyOf.description:
Usage: Configure automatic retry.
Inputs: Supply enabled.
Invariants: This is separate from aborting a pending retry.
Effects: Enables or disables future automatic retries.
Recovery: Inspect current configuration after uncertainty.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_set_auto_retry

anyOf.description:
Usage: Abort a pending retry.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Already completed work is not rolled back.
Effects: Signals the pending retry to stop.
Recovery: Inspect session activity after uncertainty.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_abort_retry

anyOf.description:
Usage: Abort the active shell command.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Aborting cannot undo effects the command already made.
Effects: Signals the shell execution to stop.
Recovery: Inspect shell result and external state after uncertainty.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_abort_bash

anyOf.description:
Usage: Replace session todo phases.
Inputs: Supply the complete phases array with tasks and statuses.
Invariants: This replaces rather than patches the existing phases.
Effects: Commits the supplied todo state and returns the resulting phases.
Recovery: Read session state after uncertainty before replacing again.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_set_todos

anyOf.description:
Usage: Set steering queue mode.
Inputs: mode is all or one-at-a-time.
Invariants: The setting is session-only and is not persisted.
Effects: Changes how steering messages are consumed.
Recovery: Read state and reapply the desired mode after restart.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_set_steering_mode

anyOf.description:
Usage: Set follow-up queue mode.
Inputs: mode is all or one-at-a-time.
Invariants: The setting is session-only and is not persisted.
Effects: Changes how follow-up messages are consumed.
Recovery: Read state and reapply the desired mode after restart.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_set_follow_up_mode

anyOf.description:
Usage: Set interrupt mode.
Inputs: mode is immediate or wait.
Invariants: The setting is session-only and is not persisted.
Effects: Changes how the session handles interruptions.
Recovery: Read state and reapply the desired mode after restart.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_set_interrupt_mode

anyOf.description:
Usage: List user messages available for branching.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Entry ids refer to the current session tree.
Effects: Reads branch candidates without navigating.
Recovery: Refresh after session or tree changes.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_get_branch_messages

anyOf.description:
Usage: Read the live transcript.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: This is the current in-memory transcript and may change during a run.
Effects: Reads messages without modifying them.
Recovery: Refresh after reconnecting or use bounded paging while idle.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_get_messages

anyOf.description:
Usage: Read a bounded page of the live transcript.
Inputs: Omit cursor for the first page; limit defaults to 100 and is at most 256.
Invariants: Pages are bounded by a byte budget; a transcript change makes cursors stale and streaming or compaction rejects paging.
Effects: Reads an in-memory snapshot without modifying the transcript.
Recovery: Restart from the first page after a stale cursor or once the session is idle.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_get_messages_page

anyOf.description:
Usage: Export the transcript to HTML.
Inputs: outputPath may be omitted to use the default.
Invariants: The result returns the output path.
Effects: Writes an HTML file to disk.
Recovery: Inspect the output path after uncertainty before exporting again.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_export_html

anyOf.description:
Usage: Compact the current session with an OMP handoff summary.
Inputs: Optional string customInstructions guides the summary.
Invariants: Compaction runs in the background without interrupting an active response. OMP rejects overlapping compaction or a session transition.
Effects: Updates the current session's context, not a separate session. The runner waits for compaction to finish before replying with {}; compaction errors fail the command.
Recovery: If delivery is uncertain, inspect session state and manual_compaction_end before retrying.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_handoff

anyOf.description:
Usage: Inspect the current session's observed subagent roster.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: The in-memory roster only knows lifecycle events observed since watching began, ordered by index then id.
Effects: Returns a snapshot without changing subagents.
Recovery: Refresh the snapshot; it is not a durable complete history.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_get_subagents

fromByte.description: UTF-8 byte offset; defaults to zero and is truncated to a nonnegative integer.

sessionFile.description: Previously observed transcript path owned by the current session.

subagentId.description: Observed subagent id; when supplied it takes precedence over sessionFile.

anyOf.description:
Usage: Incrementally read an owned subagent transcript.
Inputs: Identify it by subagentId or sessionFile; fromByte defaults to zero and is a UTF-8 byte offset.
Invariants: Only current-session-owned transcripts are accessible; only newline-complete entries advance nextByte. An offset past EOF resets to zero.
Effects: Reads the transcript file without modifying it; messages are the message entries in order.
Recovery: Resume at nextByte; on reset discard the old view and rebuild from zero.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_get_subagent_messages

allOf.description: Select no forwarding, lifecycle/progress, or full subagent event forwarding for this session.

anyOf.description:
Usage: Subscribe to subagent updates.
Inputs: Supply the desired subscription level.
Invariants: The result is null when the host owns subscription lifecycle; otherwise it reports the level.
Effects: Changes update subscription state.
Recovery: Restore the desired subscription after reconnecting.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_set_subagent_subscription

anyOf.description:
Usage: List OAuth providers and authentication state.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Availability comes from the provider catalog and authentication from credential storage.
Effects: Reads current in-process registry and stored credential state.
Recovery: Refresh the list after login or logout.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_get_login_providers

anyOf.description:
Usage: Authenticate an OAuth provider interactively.
Inputs: providerId names a known provider; answer numeric-id prompts with login_input_response.
Invariants: Prompts time out after ten minutes; omitted or null answers cancel the input.
Effects: Stores credentials, refreshes provider discovery online and refreshes scoped models.
Recovery: Check authentication state after uncertainty; login may have stored credentials before a refresh failed.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_login

anyOf.description:
Usage: Request composer ghost text.
Inputs: text and cursor, an in-range UTF-16 offset.
Invariants: Disabled prediction, ineligible cursor positions and superseded waiting requests return null.
Effects: May invoke the configured prediction backend; concurrent typing is coalesced.
Recovery: Request again with current text and cursor rather than applying stale suffixes.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_predict_word

anyOf.description:
Usage: Propose commits for the workspace while the session is settled.
Inputs: Optional context guides the proposal; changelog false disables changelog detection. Optional requestId correlates unsolicited commit_plan_progress frames.
Invariants: Returns null if no staged changes remain after staging the workspace; progress is emitted only when requestId is supplied.
Effects: Stages all workspace changes, including partially staged files; may invoke a model.
Recovery: Inspect the Git index after errors or lost responses; staging is not rolled back.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_commit_plan

plan.description: Generated single or split commit plan, its changelog edits, warnings and fallback indicator.

items.description: Proposed changelog entries and optional deletions grouped by section for a repository path.
Proposed commit message and files, optionally narrowing changes to hunks and declaring dependencies on other commits.

end.description: Inclusive end line; must be at least start.

items.description: Select all changes, one-based hunk indices, or an inclusive line range in a repository-relative file.

anyOf.description:
Usage: Apply a proposed or edited commit plan while the session is settled.
Inputs: plan contains commit groups, dependencies and changelog proposals.
Invariants: Split plans must cover staged files and have valid dependency order.
Effects: Writes changelogs and creates commits; split plans unstage and stage hunks in dependency order.
Recovery: Inspect commits, changelog and index after failure; partial application is not rolled back.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_commit_apply

anyOf.description:
Usage: Generate a PR title and body from the current branch and staged diff.
Inputs: base is a Git ref; context and plannedMessages are optional.
Invariants: Commits are oldest first; the staged diff is bounded and generation requires changes.
Effects: Reads Git and session history and calls the configured model; does not create a PR.
Recovery: Retry generation if needed; output can differ and malformed model output falls back to the log.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_generate_pr_description

anyOf.description:
Usage: Report whether a prediction was accepted.
Inputs: text, UTF-16 cursor, suggestion and accepted flag.
Invariants: Feedback is ignored when prediction is off or the cursor is ineligible.
Effects: Sends feedback to the configured prediction backend when applicable.
Recovery: A lost response does not establish whether feedback was recorded.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_predict_word_feedback

anyOf.description:
Usage: Ask a side question or continue an existing record.
Inputs: question is text; omit recordId to start a record.
Invariants: Only one side question runs at a time; deltas and snapshots carry recordId.
Effects: Streams an answer and checkpoints turns to the session history sidecar.
Recovery: Inspect history after an uncertain response before submitting another question.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_btw

anyOf.description:
Usage: Cancel the active side question.
Inputs: Omit recordId to target the active record, or supply its id.
Invariants: cancelled reports whether a matching active request was cancelled.
Effects: Interrupts the answer; its lifecycle is checkpointed.
Recovery: Read history to determine the outcome if the response is lost.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_btw_cancel

anyOf.description:
Usage: Read side-question history for the current session.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Records are newest first and include follow-up turns.
Effects: Reads the session history sidecar without changing it.
Recovery: Retry a failed read; history reflects saved checkpoints.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_get_btw_history

anyOf.description:
Usage: List jobs and services scoped to the current session.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: This is a live snapshot; a service-list failure appears in servicesError.
Effects: Reads runner and daemon state without starting work.
Recovery: Refresh the snapshot after a restart or service-list failure.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_get_jobs

generation.description: Runner generation from the job snapshot.

incarnation.description: Identity token from the job snapshot; detects replacement.

anyOf.description:
Usage: Read one job or service's output.
Inputs: Supply its id, kind, incarnation and generation from a current snapshot; cursor defaults to zero.
Invariants: Identity is bound to the runner generation and job incarnation; bash sources honor the cursor, while service logs and non-stream sources return bounded snapshots from zero. Output may be truncated.
Effects: Reads current output without cancelling the job.
Recovery: On stale_generation or job_not_found refresh the list; invalid_args requires correcting the request.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_get_job_output

generation.description: Runner generation from the job snapshot.

incarnation.description: Identity token from the job snapshot; detects replacement.

anyOf.description:
Usage: Request cancellation of a scoped job or service.
Inputs: Supply its id, kind, incarnation and generation from a current snapshot.
Invariants: A cancellation request is not proof that work has stopped; stale identities and forbidden targets fail.
Effects: Signals the selected job or service; already produced output is not rolled back.
Recovery: Refresh the snapshot and inspect status after uncertainty; do not reuse an identity from a replaced runner.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_cancel_job

anyOf.description:
Usage: Recover correlation for one to 32 unique client message IDs.
Inputs: Supply unique nonempty IDs up to 128 characters each.
Invariants: Status reflects this session's in-flight and journaled input; bounded responses can omit oversized native messages.
Effects: Reads correlation state without submitting input.
Recovery: Use session history when messages are omitted; do not treat an uncertain transport as proof of non-admission.

Browser: Reconciliation does not start a child; a missing child or uncertain host fails instead of guessing acceptance.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_get_client_message_status

clientMessageId.description: Session-scoped correlation identity; use status reconciliation after uncertain delivery.

images.description: Optional inline image content accompanying the input.

data.description: Base64-encoded image data.

mimeType.description: Image media type.

message.description: User input text submitted to the session.

uploadProofs.description: Private upload completion proofs keyed by upload ID; never forwarded to the runner.

uploads.description: Completed upload IDs attached before the native command is sent.

anyOf.description:
Usage: Submit user input to the session.
Inputs: Provide message and optional images, clientMessageId and streamingBehavior.
Invariants: The reply acknowledges admission, not completion; local builtins can report agentInvoked without a normal agent turn. A clientMessageId is unique within the session's correlation journal, not a global retry key.
Effects: Runs input hooks and may enqueue or start an agent turn.
Recovery: Reconcile an uncertain correlated submission with get_client_message_status; observe prompt result and settled state separately.

Browser: Submit a prompt; while a shell is running it is queued as follow-up. Local slash commands may report agentInvoked:false. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_prompt

clientMessageId.description: Session-scoped correlation identity; use status reconciliation after uncertain delivery.

images.description: Optional inline image content accompanying the input.

data.description: Base64-encoded image data.

mimeType.description: Image media type.

message.description: User input text submitted to the session.

uploadProofs.description: Private upload completion proofs keyed by upload ID; never forwarded to the runner.

uploads.description: Completed upload IDs attached before the native command is sent.

anyOf.description:
Usage: Steer the current run.
Inputs: Provide message, optional images and clientMessageId.
Invariants: Admission is ordered with other user input; acknowledgement is not turn completion.
Effects: Delivers or queues steering input after input hooks.
Recovery: Reconcile an uncertain correlated input before sending another.

Browser: Steer a live run; while a shell is running it is queued as follow-up. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_steer

clientMessageId.description: Session-scoped correlation identity; use status reconciliation after uncertain delivery.

images.description: Optional inline image content accompanying the input.

data.description: Base64-encoded image data.

mimeType.description: Image media type.

message.description: User input text submitted to the session.

uploadProofs.description: Private upload completion proofs keyed by upload ID; never forwarded to the runner.

uploads.description: Completed upload IDs attached before the native command is sent.

anyOf.description:
Usage: Enqueue follow-up input.
Inputs: Provide message, optional images and clientMessageId.
Invariants: Acknowledgement follows admission, not completion; the queue is session state.
Effects: Adds follow-up input for the agent.
Recovery: Reconcile an uncertain correlated input and inspect the queue before resubmitting.

Browser: Queue a follow-up message. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_follow_up

anyOf.description:
Usage: Remove a matching queued message.
Inputs: Supply message text and steering or followUp queue.
Invariants: The result says whether a match was found and includes its images when present.
Effects: Removes the matching queued input.
Recovery: Inspect the queue after an uncertain response before removing again.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_remove_queued_message

anyOf.description:
Usage: Promote a queued message.
Inputs: Supply its message text.
Invariants: The result reports whether a match was promoted.
Effects: Changes the queued message's priority.
Recovery: Inspect the queue after an uncertain response.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_promote_queued_message

anyOf.description:
Usage: Abort and recover queued input for an editor.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Queue entries are withdrawn before abort so the interrupted run cannot consume them.
Effects: Stops the run and returns steering and follow-up messages; prior effects are not rolled back.
Recovery: Restore the returned messages in the editor; inspect session state if the response was lost.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_abort_and_restore_queue

hostId.description: Host holding the session to resume.

anyOf.description:
Usage: Read live session state.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: This is a current in-process snapshot, not a durable history or completion guarantee.
Effects: Reads model, queue, goal, tools and activity state without submitting work.
Recovery: Refresh after reconnecting or when state changes.

Browser: Read browser state, including wrapper activity and extension UI state. Optional hostId selects the host for this session; a live wrapper on another host is refused. The routing hint is not sent to the runner. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_get_state

anyOf.description:
Usage: Select an exact provider and model for this session.
Inputs: Supply both provider and modelId.
Invariants: A miss waits for background discovery and refreshes that provider on the session's host before failing.
Effects: Changes the active session model.
Recovery: Read state or available models after an uncertain response before selecting again.

Browser: Select the model; the browser receives its id and provider. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_set_model

anyOf.description:
Usage: Set fast mode.
Inputs: Supply enabled.
Invariants: Enabled and active are distinct: the current model determines whether fast mode is active.
Effects: Changes the session fast-mode setting.
Recovery: Read state after uncertainty before reapplying.

Browser: Enable or disable fast mode; the wrapper reports effective and active state. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_set_fast_mode

anyOf.description:
Usage: Set slow mode.
Inputs: Supply enabled.
Invariants: Support and scope depend on the current session model.
Effects: Changes the slow-mode setting and returns its effective enabled state.
Recovery: Read state after uncertainty before reapplying.

Browser: Enable or disable slow mode; the wrapper reports effective state. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_set_slow_mode

anyOf.description:
Usage: Prepare a user message for editing by moving the leaf before it.
Inputs: Supply the user message entryId.
Invariants: The session must have no snapshot-busy or pending asynchronous work; the old branch remains in the tree.
Effects: Persists the navigation, but does not submit edited text.
Recovery: Inspect session identity and leaf after uncertainty before editing or resending.

Browser: Move the history leaf before a user message; fails with invalid_edit_target, session_busy, session_changed or session_edit_unsupported when preflight cannot safely edit. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_edit_message

anyOf.description:
Usage: Fork a session snapshot at an optional entry.
Inputs: entryId may be omitted.
Invariants: The session must be idle for a consistent snapshot; idleness is rechecked after awaits.
Effects: Switches to the fork unless cancelled.
Recovery: Inspect current session identity after uncertainty; retry session_busy only once work has settled.

Browser: Branch at a user message and switch this process to the new session. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_fork

anyOf.description:
Usage: Create a session, optionally linked to a parent.
Inputs: parentSession may be omitted.
Invariants: A cancelled change does not detach the current run.
Effects: On success switches the process to the new session.
Recovery: Inspect current identity after uncertainty before creating another session.

Browser: Switch the runner session and return its refreshed identity when not cancelled. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_new_session

anyOf.description:
Usage: Switch to a session file.
Inputs: Supply sessionPath and optionally both provider and modelId.
Invariants: A cancelled switch leaves the current session in place.
Effects: On success changes session and may detach a live run.
Recovery: Inspect current identity after uncertainty before switching again.

Browser: Switch the runner session and return its refreshed identity when not cancelled. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_switch_session

anyOf.description:
Usage: Compact session context.
Inputs: customInstructions may be omitted.
Invariants: Compaction may be aborted and is not a transcript deletion guarantee.
Effects: Produces and persists a compacted context summary.
Recovery: Inspect session state and history after uncertainty before compacting again.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_compact

anyOf.description:
Usage: Abort in-flight compaction.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: This requests cancellation rather than reversing a completed compaction.
Effects: Signals the compaction operation to stop.
Recovery: Inspect compaction state and history after uncertainty.

Browser: Abort in-flight compaction through the runner abort operation. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_abort_compaction

anyOf.description:
Usage: Set the session title.
Inputs: Supply name; surrounding whitespace is trimmed.
Invariants: The title belongs to the current session.
Effects: Changes the session name.
Recovery: Read current state after uncertainty before reapplying.

Browser: Set and cache the trimmed session name. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_set_session_name

anyOf.description:
Usage: Read session usage statistics.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Statistics describe the current session snapshot.
Effects: Reads usage without changing the session.
Recovery: Refresh after further activity.

Browser: Read session statistics with the wrapper's current session name. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_get_session_stats

anyOf.description:
Usage: Read the latest assistant text.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Text is omitted when there is no assistant text.
Effects: Reads the current transcript without modifying it.
Recovery: Refresh after the transcript changes.

Browser: Read the latest assistant text, defaulting to an empty string. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_get_last_assistant_text

anyOf.description:
Usage: List available slash commands.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: The list reflects current session capabilities.
Effects: Reads the current command registry.
Recovery: Refresh after extensions or session configuration change.

Browser: Dispatches the runner's get_available_commands operation.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_get_commands

anyOf.description:
Usage: Restart the session process.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: A successful response reports that restart was requested, not that an interrupted prompt completed.
Effects: Replaces the process and its in-memory state.
Recovery: Refresh session state and reconcile outstanding input after restart.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_reload

anyOf.description: Submitted ask dialog results, preserving question IDs, selections and optional custom input.
Submitted whole-form dialog result keyed by control name; controls with no chosen value can be omitted.

data.description:
A submitted whole-form ask (omp's `formDialog`), by control `name`: radios, single checkboxes and
single selects give their value (omitted when nothing is chosen), checkbox groups and multi-selects
an array, `number`/`range` inputs a number, other text fields their text. Mirrors pi-tui's html-form.

anyOf.description: Approval decision: once, session, deny, or a folder/target grant with persistence choice.

value.description: Dialog return value selected by method; cancellation sends no value rather than a value of null.

anyOf.description:
Usage: Answer a pending runner dialog or server confirmation.
Inputs: Supply the dialog id and optional answer value.
Invariants: Invalid ids or answers fail with invalid_ui_response.
Effects: Resolves the matching pending interaction.
Recovery: Refresh pending UI state after uncertainty; an already resolved dialog is not a new request.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_ui_response

anyOf.description:
Usage: Send keyboard input to a custom extension UI component.
Inputs: Supply its numeric id and input data.
Invariants: Input targets the currently active component identified by id.
Effects: Forwards input to the extension UI.
Recovery: Refresh UI state after a disconnect before sending further input.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_ui_input

anyOf.description:
Usage: Execute a shell command while streaming bash_output frames.
Inputs: Supply command and optionally excludeFromContext.
Invariants: Output frames are incremental; the result follows execution.
Effects: Runs a shell command with its ordinary filesystem and process side effects.
Recovery: Inspect external state after uncertainty; rerunning a shell command may duplicate side effects.

Browser: Execute a shell command; deferred indicates the result was held for the next prompt. Where the native operation returns undefined, the browser wrapper returns null.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_bash

allOf.description: Host tool catalog installed into the current runner session.

tools.description: Complete replacement catalog; each tool's parameters is a host-defined JSON Schema.

^(.*)$.description: Extensible tool-defined JSON payload.

anyOf.description:
Usage: Register host-provided tools for the session.
Inputs: Supply the host tool definitions.
Invariants: Definitions are merged with enabled web-server tools.
Effects: Changes the tools exposed to the runner.
Recovery: Re-register host tools when the owning host reconnects.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_set_host_tools

allOf.description: Host tool completion correlated to the request id; isError distinguishes a failed result.

result.description: Extensible JSON data supplied by the provider, tool, or extension.

anyOf.description:
Usage: Return a result for a pending host tool call.
Inputs: Supply the result frame fields without the type discriminator.
Invariants: The result belongs to the corresponding host tool invocation.
Effects: Forwards the result to the runner.
Recovery: Reconcile pending calls after a disconnect rather than inventing a result.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_host_tool_result

allOf.description: URI scheme registrations owned by the connected host bridge.

schemes.description: Complete replacement set of host-owned URI schemes.

anyOf.description:
Usage: Register host URI schemes.
Inputs: Supply the schemes supported by the host.
Invariants: Registration describes host capabilities, not URI operation results.
Effects: Updates schemes available to the runner.
Recovery: Re-register capabilities after the host reconnects.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_set_host_uri_schemes

allOf.description: Host URI response correlated by id, carrying content or error details.

anyOf.description:
Usage: Return a result for a pending host URI operation.
Inputs: Supply the result frame fields without the type discriminator.
Invariants: The result belongs to the corresponding URI request.
Effects: Forwards the result to the runner.
Recovery: Reconcile pending requests after a disconnect rather than inventing a result.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_host_uri_result

anyOf.description:
Usage: Obtain the scope for a durable outbox entry.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: The scope is nonsecret and binds entries to the installation and sign-in.
Effects: Reads the current scope without dispatching input.
Recovery: Refresh the scope after a sign-in change before adding entries.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_outbox_scope

mode.description: Delivery mode captured with the intent: prompt, follow-up or steering input to the native runner.

uploadProofs.description: Private upload completion proofs keyed by upload ID; never forwarded to the runner.

uploads.description: Completed upload IDs attached before the native command is sent.

anyOf.description:
Usage: Durably accept a held outbox message, independently of its eventual delivery.
Inputs: Supply id and scope; first insertion also requires mode and message. Images and completed uploads are optional; replaces identifies an earlier entry.
Invariants: Reusing an existing id on the same host returns its stored receipt, including the owning host ID, without dispatching again. Replacing a failed or delivered entry requires the same original payload; pending originals cannot be replaced. Scope, upload, size and capacity checks can reject the request.
Effects: Stores an entry for later delivery; acceptance does not mean the runner has admitted or completed a prompt.
Recovery: Retry an uncertain insertion with the same id and scope to recover its receipt; resolve scope or payload conflicts rather than changing the original intent.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_outbox_add

anyOf.description:
Usage: Retire an undelivered outbox entry.
Inputs: Supply its id.
Invariants: An entry already delivering cannot be removed and fails with outbox_dispatched.
Effects: Removes an eligible held entry; this does not cancel an already dispatched prompt.
Recovery: Inspect the outbox and delivery status after an uncertain response.
anyOf.title: AgentCommand_outbox_remove

command.description: Every accepted existing-session agent command. ensure_session belongs only to POST /api/agent/new.
command.title: AgentCommand

BrowserCommand.title: BrowserCommand

BrowserEvent.description: Multiplexed subscription event: name chooses the subscribed channel or mux controls; data is a JSON value and the worker preserves its serialization. Consumers decode by channel and inner discriminator. Session cursors are independent of link acknowledgements; a merged delta's web.first marks the first sequence represented, and a snapshot inside that range cannot safely apply it.

anyOf.description: Initial connection identity and browser transport setting.

connectionId.description: Identifier used to attach subscriptions to this connection.

serverId.description: Server instance identifier used to distinguish server restarts.

image.description:
Image block. omp persists the flat {data, mimeType} shape (data may be a
`blob:sha256:` reference until resolved); legacy pi entries used the nested
Anthropic-style `source` shape. The UI handles both. Tool-result images
reach the browser as `url` (`/api/media/<sha256>`, `?thumb=1` for a small
preview) instead of inline base64.
